apply.description: References not yet installed are resolved for {version} and installed, tagged with the profile. Nothing is ever removed by an apply.
apply.title: Apply a global profile

capture.description: Snapshots options.txt and config/ from the shared store. Launches under this profile then keep their own settings; worlds stay shared.
capture.title: Capture settings for {name}?

create.description: A profile is a named selection over this instance's installed content — nothing is copied.
create.title: Create profile

profile.empty: No profiles yet. A profile picks which installed content mirrors into the game at launch.

global.description: Reusable content lists applied into any instance — each reference resolves against that instance's version and loader.
global.empty: No global profiles yet. Build a reference list once, apply it to any instance.
global.title: Global profiles

members.description: Members mirror into the game at launch; deselected items are removed from the game folder (their files stay managed, and untracked files are never touched).
members.empty: Nothing installed to select — add mods, resource packs, or shaders first.
members.title: Select content — {name}

profile.none_active: No profile active — everything installed mirrors at launch.

release.description: The profile's settings store is deleted and the profile follows the shared settings again.
release.title: Release captured settings?

remove.description: The selection is deleted; the installed content itself stays.
remove.title: Remove {name}?
